children: Azenta received full repayment of the $35,000,000 vendor loan and has now received the full $63,000,000 cash purchase price for B Medical Systems.
Thelema repaid the $35,000,000 vendor loan plus accrued interest on Sept 3, 2026, in the aggregate amount of $35,373,333.
Repayment occurred prior to maturity, terminating the Vendor Loan Agreement and releasing the share pledge on B Medical.
With the loan repaid, Azenta has received the entire $63,000,000 purchase price for B Medical in cash.
Transaction retirement eliminates Azenta's credit exposure related to the sale and completes the divestiture of B Medical Systems.
